purpose: Untouched external validation of whether quantitative Thalassia meadow state predicts next-year recorded-state instability in an independent fixed-transect seagrass monitoring program.

relationship_to_tampa_discovery.frozen_hypothesis: Among annual fixed-transect years with recorded Thalassia testudinum presence, lower source-year within-transect frequency and abundance add out-of-time information about next-year recorded loss beyond a conventional space/time/effort baseline.

source.provider: Florida Department of Environmental Protection, Office of Resilience and Coastal Protection, Charlotte Harbor Aquatic Preserves
source.method: Fixed transects with repeat 1 m x 1 m quadrats; total and species-specific SAV evaluated by Braun-Blanquet; blade length and shoot counts also recorded.

qualification_reason.notes: Program metadata explicitly documents annual fixed transects, repeat quadrats, species-specific Braun-Blanquet abundance, shoot counts and blade lengths. This is closer to the Tampa observation hierarchy than a raster or one-off field survey.

declared_program_filters.reason: These exclusions are stated on the public Program 570 metadata page and are frozen before response access.

scientific_estimand.annual_unit: stable fixed transect x calendar year
scientific_estimand.source_eligibility: Thalassia testudinum recorded present in source year
scientific_estimand.target: same stable fixed transect in the immediately following sampled calendar year
scientific_estimand.primary_endpoint: next-year recorded loss of Thalassia testudinum
scientific_estimand.recorded_loss: no positive Thalassia quadrat in target transect-year under the frozen sampling denominator
scientific_estimand.recorded_persistence: at least one positive Thalassia quadrat in target transect-year
scientific_estimand.interpretation: Recorded-state transition only; never demographic extinction, mortality, or true colonization.

quantitative_predictors.frequency: positive Thalassia repeat quadrats divided by all eligible repeat quadrats in the source transect-year
quantitative_predictors.abundance: mean species-specific Thalassia Braun-Blanquet abundance across all eligible repeat quadrats in the source transect-year, with structurally sampled Thalassia-negative quadrats contributing zero
quantitative_predictors.blade_length_and_shoot_count: secondary descriptive variables only; they may not replace frequency or Braun-Blanquet abundance to rescue the primary endpoint

numeric: cyclic survey timing when an actual survey date is available
categorical: managed area or equivalent prospectively declared geographic stratum

split_and_model.split: strict walk-forward by target calendar year; train only on transitions with target year earlier than the scored target year
split_and_model.numeric_scaling: StandardScaler fitted on each training set only
split_and_model.categorical_encoding: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') fitted on each training set only
split_and_model.only_allowed_arm_difference: source-year Thalassia frequency plus Braun-Blanquet abundance

secondary_metrics: ROC AUC when pooled labels contain both classes
scoring.aggregation: unweighted mean of scored target-year log losses
scoring.favorable: augmented macro log loss < baseline AND augmented wins in at least ceil(0.60 * scored target years)
scoring.adverse: baseline macro log loss < augmented AND baseline wins in at least ceil(0.60 * scored target years)

stage1_schema_rule.purpose: After source acquisition, map workbook/table and header semantics before any predictive model fitting or score calculation.
allowed: row counts without focal response summaries
stage1_schema_rule.post_access_alias_or_semantic_repair: forbidden within v1; a schema mismatch terminates v1

no_rescue_rules: Do not switch focal taxon after response access.

Do not change fixed-transect eligibility, annualization, source/target transition definition, quantitative predictors, baseline semantics, learner, estimability minima, scoring metric, or decision rule after response access.
Do not substitute blade length, shoot density, total SAV, another seagrass species, or a different Program 570 table to rescue a null, adverse, non-estimable, or schema-stop result.
Do not drop a managed area, station, transect, year, or adverse target year based on observed focal outcomes.
Do not reinterpret recorded loss as demographic extinction.
Any post-access parser/schema failure terminates v1; a repaired parser requires a separately versioned methodological follow-up and cannot count as this untouched confirmation.
next_gate: authorized source acquisition and schema-only preflight; predictive response remains unopened at this Stage0 freeze
